Purpose
- Brief, actionable guidance to help an AI assistant be immediately productive in this repository.

Quick start (local dev)
- Run frontend (Vite): `npm run dev` (served from the `src`/`app` React codebase).
- Run local helper API: `npm run server` (starts `server/server.ts` on port 3001).
- Run both: `npm run dev:all` (uses `concurrently`).
- Deploy Supabase Edge Function (serverless API): `npx supabase functions deploy server` (the repo includes a workspace task for this).

High level architecture
- Frontend: TypeScript + React (Vite) in `src/app` and legacy `app/` pages — UI components are under `src/app/components`.
- Local dev API: lightweight Express server in [server/server.ts](server/server.ts) used for local file-based data and uploads.
- Cloud API / business logic: Supabase Edge Function in [supabase/functions/server/index.ts](supabase/functions/server/index.ts) (Hono on Deno). This implements auth, cadet/points/tickets, and uses a key-value table helper.
- Persistent store: Supabase-backed KV table accessed via [supabase/functions/server/kv_store.tsx](supabase/functions/server/kv_store.tsx). Public JSON snapshots also exist under `public/data` and `data/` for static usage and tests.
- Support scripts: `scripts/` contains utilities (CSV export, presentation generation, migrations). Treat these as single-purpose helpers.

Important developer workflows & commands
- Local dev: `npm run dev` + `npm run server`. The server writes to `data/*.json` and `data/uploads` for file uploads.
- Building frontend: `npm run build` (Vite).
- Preview build: `npm run preview`.
- Supabase functions: The serverless code is Deno/Hono; set environment variables (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) before deploying or running in Supabase. Use `npx supabase functions deploy server` to publish.
- Tasks: check `.github/workflows` — CI automations exist (see `.github/workflows/*`).

Conventions and project-specific patterns
- Autogenerated files: `supabase/functions/server/kv_store.tsx` and `utils/supabase/info.tsx` are autogenerated. Don't manually edit them — update the generator or source instead.
- Key prefixes in KV: keys are namespaced with prefixes like `cadet:`, `point:`, `ticket:`, `notification:`. Use `getByPrefix('cadet:')` to list cadets.
- Route prefixes: many serverless routes use a legacy prefix `/make-server-73a3871f/` alongside public aliases (e.g. `/public/cadets`). When adding new endpoints, maintain both patterns if backward-compatibility is needed.
- Roles & auth model: user metadata includes `role` (cadet, staff, snco, pointgiver) and optional `cadetId`/`cadetName`. Business logic often gates by role — consult [supabase/functions/server/index.ts](supabase/functions/server/index.ts) for examples.

Secrets and environment
- Do NOT commit secrets. The repo README calls out `.env` usage. Frontend reads `VITE_ADMIN_PIN` and other `VITE_` vars. Serverless functions read `SUPABASE_*` env vars.
- There is an autogenerated `utils/supabase/info.tsx` containing `projectId` and `publicAnonKey`. Treat the service role key and other secrets as environment-only.

- KV store helper (do not edit): [supabase/functions/server/kv_store.tsx](supabase/functions/server/kv_store.tsx)

- Project scripts: [package.json](package.json) `scripts` section.
